accelerators.Name: Run Isolation
accelerators.Detail: Each run writes into an isolated append-only run folder.

accelerators.Name: Timeout Guard
accelerators.Detail: Child processes run via ProcessStartInfo with timeout + kill; parent never hangs.

accelerators.Name: AST Before Invoke
accelerators.Detail: PS files are parse-checked (child-process fallback) before being trusted.

accelerators.Name: Module Cache First
accelerators.Detail: Installed modules detected before any network install.

accelerators.Name: Network Retry Lite
accelerators.Detail: Install failure becomes WARN, not fatal; engine continues.

accelerators.Name: Hash Inventory
accelerators.Detail: SHA256 records guard against uncontrolled overwrite.

accelerators.Name: Bridge Wrapper
accelerators.Detail: Other scripts import one stable .psm1 instead of raw tool paths.

accelerators.Name: Low-Memory Scan
accelerators.Detail: Streaming file inventory avoids loading the whole tree.

accelerators.Name: Hydra Gate
accelerators.Detail: Parse errors block broad autofix; parallel-safe split from sequential.

accelerators.Name: HTML Matrix
accelerators.Detail: Every phase emits CSV/JSON/HTML for review and later integration.
